description:
object 0.39 cannot take ruzstd >= 0.9.1 (the RUSTSEC-2026-0344 fix); object 0.40 can, and cranelift-object accepts object 0.40 from 0.136. fz shares object types with cranelift-object (ir_codegen/backend.rs MachOBuildVersion), so both move together.

Measured trial (cranelift 0.131 -> 0.136, object 0.39 -> 0.40, reverted): 59 errors and 60 deprecation warnings, mostly in compiler2/native_codegen (fn_ctx, prim, receive, terminator, runtime_test):
- MemFlags::new() / MemFlags::trusted() removed (47 errors)
- methods whose arity changed (10 errors), 2 type mismatches
- iadd_imm / bxor_imm / bor_imm deprecated in favour of _s (sign-extending) / _u (zero-extending) variants: each call site must choose by the immediate's meaning.

Needs a paper first: which memflags each removed constructor maps to, and the sign choice per imm call site. Acceptance: builds with no warnings; three-path parity (interp, JIT, AOT); full gate; census outputs identical against develop.
title: Move cranelift to 0.136 and object to 0.40
